tools.description: Resolve any DNS record live via Google Public DNS. Answers: is DNS propagated? What are the MX/TXT/SPF/DKIM records? Where does this CNAME point? For reverse lookup pass name=<reversed-ip>.in-addr.arpa with type=PTR (e.g. 90.57.149.3.in-addr.arpa for 3.149.57.90). Returns Status (0 = NOERROR, 3 = NXDOMAIN), Answer records with TTLs, and the AD flag for DNSSEC validation.

do.description: Set 'true' to include DNSSEC records (RRSIG) in the response

name.description: Domain name to resolve, e.g. 'kaiv.ai' (or reversed IP + .in-addr.arpa for PTR)

type.description: Record type: A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME, SOA, CAA, PTR, SRV. Default A.

tools.name: resolve_dns
tools.title: Resolve Dns
